scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 concurrently -k -n NEXT,ELECTRON_BUILD,ELECTRON -c cyan,yellow,magenta "next dev -p 3000" "tsup src/electron/main.ts src/electron/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --out-dir dist/electron --sourcemap --external electron --watch" "wait-on dist/electron/main.js http://127.0.0.1:3000 && cross-env NEXT_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 electron ."
scripts.build:electron: tsup src/electron/main.ts src/electron/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --out-dir dist/electron --sourcemap --external electron
scripts.build: npm run build:next && npm run build:electron
